corrections.proposed: 1910 built (first tower); enclosed cab 1914; cab enlarged 1924; steel replacement 1939
corrections.why: The Forest Service dates the first tower to 1910. 1926 appears on firelookout.com only as the year of a named lookout on the personnel list.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 7,166 ft (2,184 m), which matches the brief. The Forest Service page says 7,200 ft. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The 1939 steel tower and L-4 cab are supported by at least two sources (register and firelookout.com) and the Forest Service. The 1910 first tower rests on the Forest Service page alone; a 1915 newspaper item shows a lookout station by then. Access 'public' is an inference from the register's road note and the Forest Service description of recreationist use; the Forest Service page is undated and nothing says whether the cab may be climbed. Height 9.1 m converts the 30-ft figure.
